```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The right to vote and to have your vote counted is an essential American freedom.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to laws that place unnecessary restrictions on those seeking to exercise the right to vote.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"During the Obama administration, the Justice Department initiated careful, thorough, and independent reviews of proposed voting changes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"During the Obama administration, the Justice Department prevented states from implementing voter identification laws that would be harmful to minority voters.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Voter identification laws can disproportionately burden young voters, people of color, low-income families, people with disabilities, and the elderly.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Refusal to allow the use of political pretexts to disenfranchise American citizens.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Every citizen of the United States is entitled to equal citizenship rights, including the 638,000 residents of the nation's capital who pay federal taxes without representation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"American citizens who live in Washington, D.C., should have full and equal congressional rights like the citizens of the 50 states.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The laws and budget of Washington, D.C.'s local government should be respected without congressional interference.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
